name: Magical Bringer Corona
original_name: まじかるブリンガーころな
source:
The story follows Korona, a girl who dreams of becoming a magical girl, as she accidentally summons Stormbringer, a gigantic 3-meter-long magic sword.

This is a chaotic comedy where Korona and the magic sword wreak havoc.

[Translated from [url=https://www.vector.co.jp/soft/win95/game/se357051.html]Vector[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了一个梦想成为魔法少女的女孩科罗娜，她无意中召唤出了一把3米长的巨大魔剑“风暴使者”。

这是一部混乱的喜剧，科罗娜和魔剑造成了严重破坏。

[译自[url=https://www.vector.co.jp/soft/win95/game/se357051.html]Vector[/url]]
